notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ build @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ then@building_economy/house.png@ on side of tc opposite @resource/berrybush.png@.
Drop off resources and build @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ with 4 @resource/sheep.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ on the @resource/berrybush.png@.

Age II Macro: : Put all 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_food.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@ next to @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.png@. Rally 8 total @unit_worker/villager.png@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@.
Contract: @technology_byzantines/western-mercenary-contract-1.png@ -> Make @unit_byzantines/longbowman-2.png@ always when you have 500 Oil.
Start making @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ around @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.png@ towards @building_economy/town-center.png@ for safety.
Go heavy on gold when over 600 @resource/resource_food.webp@ to get @age/age_3.png@
At around 8 mins you should have about 10 @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.png@. Keep making them as you gather more @resource/resource_wood.png@

When you have a good @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ setup, you go age 3. You should have enough @unit_byzantines/longbowman-2.png@ and/or @unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.png@ to defend aggression.
Gather with 10+ @unit_worker/villager.png@  on @resource/resource_gold.png@ when aging. You need a ton of gold for upgrades and units.
Keep adding @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ and build more @building_military/barracks.png@ so you can spam @unit_byzantines/varangian-guard-3.png@@unit_byzantines/longbowman-2.png@

Use longbows around resources to get vision if you dont have @technology_byzantines/border-settlements-2.webp@ or @building_defensive/outpost.png@ up. You want to make @building_defensive/outpost.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@ if they are facing your enemy. Make @building_defensive/outpost.png@ on the @resource/resource_gold.png@if no forward @resource/berrybush.png@.
Be smart about your walling. Dont wall too much to conserve resources. Just wall where necessary to make it easier to defend with only longbows.

In the feudal age, start with a @building_military/barracks.png@ to make @unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.png@ vs knight rush civs (@civilization_flag/jda.png@@civilization_flag/fre.png@@civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/mon.png@) then after go into @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.png@.

+1 and +2 ranged upgrades are insanely important, Your longbows are basically crossbows for dealing with anything living and mechanical (yes, with good splits during fights, you can whittle down mangonels too very quickly)

Consider your timings. You can make a lot of units in castle and push, but when you approach 200/200 it is time for imperial. Another timing is your age 4 @unit_byzantines/longbowman-2.png@ upgrade that makes them do serious damage again vs age 3 opponent. Varangian age 4 upgrade is also insane (depending on your numbers)

name: Byzantines Fast Aggression [Beasty]
author: Sazed

notes: 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/berrybush.png@ builds @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.png@ (in zone of @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ while boosting research)
Research "Western Mercenary Contract" and Produce Longbows from @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.png@

1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.png@ build @building_byzantines/aqueduct-1.png@ to connect @landmark_byzantines/cistern-of-the-first-hill-2.png@ to @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ then back to @resource/resource_gold.png@
1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ build @building_economy/mill.png@ on @resource/deer.png@ then @building_military/stable.png@  (boost production in the cistern near the blacksmith)
1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ build @building_economy/mill.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@ and gather from that
Go 2nd TCs or make more production - many options!!
Build production @building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/stable.png@ + @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.png@ when possible (see notes for production choices)
Harass enemy with your units and slowly build up @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ for @age/age_3.png@ if you it won't kill you
1 new @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_economy/house.png@ (opposite side of gold) -> @resource/resource_gold.png@

If under pressure, hurry out units instead: @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.png@+@building_military/archery-range.png@(@building_military/stable.png@ if needed) and get @resource/resource_stone.png@for @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ by constructing buildings.

Mercenary advice: Pick "Longbow Contract" up against Camel civs and play defensive with @unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.webp@+Longbow. Pick "Keshik Contract" against other civs and run "Keshik"+@unit_cavalry/horseman-1.png@+@building_military/archery-range.png@+@unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.png@ .  The idea here is, that the "Keshik" is your anti-armor, so if your enemy goes @age/age_3.png@, you have "Keshiks" against "MAA" and @unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.png@ against "Cavalry"
As for pressure: keep responding to it. You are 2@building_economy/town-center.png@ so if you survive and don't lose too many @unit_worker/villager.png@ you will eventually win with eco.
Aggressive Walling: is key to securing more map. If under a lot of pressure, wall in the opposite of where your opponent is to take more resources.
Use "Akritoi Defense" from @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ to arm villagers with defense and spears in case of raids. Build towers on resources.

Building Layout: Construct @building_technology/blacksmith.png@+@building_technology/university.png@ around 1 @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ and use "Dialecticus" for additional research speed. Keep military production around other @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ and use "Conscriptio" for additional production speed.

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ build @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@@building_economy/house.png@ on side of tc opposite @resource/resource_gold.png@. @unit_worker/villager.png@ goes to @resource/resource_gold.png@ after
Drop off resources and build @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ with 4 @resource/sheep.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ in the influence of @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@
Queue  @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ until 3-4 then @technology_byzantines/expilatores-2.png@ after keep queueing new @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.png@.
@building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ -> Contract: Keshik is very strong & Ghulams in Castle allow for mangonels to be built in the field.

For the Byzantines, getting horsemen out early allows for quick early vill kills with Triumph from @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@. Use this ability often for dmg, movement speed and healing.

Archers as a follow up can come faster if you want it to, but most importantly, Archers should always come before mercenaries. If you go Merc Camp first, you lose too much tempo. I dislike longbows as they cost too much and are slow, so go Javelins if opponent has lots of archers, and Keshiks as standard.
Always try to gather from berries before deer because the oil gives you a lot of extra power through Mercs.
When playing aggro, you can often find a lot of damage and play only feudal, but sometimes you have to go Castle to finish a game (especially true for 1tc vs tc aggro)

Play when against aggro civs. If against passive, play the 2 TC one. Some pointers:
1. Remember to build cisterns ASAP when you get 120 stone.
2. Important to scout enemy and produce the counters in Feudal.
